execution_claim: No tests have been executed by this package.

tests.title: Clean pre-feature and candidate builds
tests.actions: Record native source revisions, build commands and executable hashes; launch/load/play/stop/quit with the same fixture.
tests.expected_observation: Both builds behave as observed; any pre-existing failure is recorded separately.

tests.title: Read-only operation sequence
tests.actions: Open/close manager, change selection/view and navigate among samples during playback.
tests.expected_observation: No musical-data changes, unsolicited notes, route changes or observable playback regression.

tests.title: Failure and undo-budget injection
tests.actions: Reject allocations/undo reservations at each transaction preparation point.
tests.expected_observation: No partial deletion/copy, lost data, stale visible state or dangling ownership.
tests.target_environment: Emulator fault injection; benign low-memory case on hardware

tests.title: UI action/keymap check
tests.actions: Use real keyboard/two-button mouse equivalents in every supported display mode.
tests.expected_observation: All actions discoverable; old bindings retained; no click-through or unintended note entry.

tests.title: Small known reference graph
tests.actions: List samples and inspect explicit references, pattern counts, format/size/loop labels and instrument dependencies.
tests.expected_observation: Counts match independently enumerated stored references; units and identities are correct.

tests.title: Unordered patterns and instrument-only events
tests.actions: Preview cleanup on references outside the song order and on instrument-only rows, including higher tracks.
tests.expected_observation: Every retained reference protects its resource; scanning is not limited to four tracks or audible rows.

tests.title: Persistent indirect/protected resources
tests.actions: Include instrument maps, defaults, existing slices, reserved slots and an unknown reference type.
tests.expected_observation: Known dependencies are retained; unknown/protected entries cannot be deleted as unused.
tests.target_environment: Emulator; available project structures on hardware

tests.title: View sort/filter and audition
tests.actions: Sort/filter if supported, select a row, explicitly audition, then open editor.
tests.expected_observation: Sorting changes no ID/notes; selection is silent; audition uses existing safe route/voice policy.

tests.title: Stale cleanup preview
tests.actions: Edit a reference or add a dependency after preview, then request apply.
tests.expected_observation: Preview is invalidated/recomputed; a newly referenced sample is not deleted.

tests.title: Preview/cancel/apply/undo/redo
tests.actions: Select a subset of truly unreferenced samples; cancel once, then apply, undo and redo.
tests.expected_observation: Cancel is unchanged; apply affects only selected IDs; undo/redo restores/removes exact data and metadata.

tests.title: Transport/preview active
tests.actions: Request destructive cleanup while song, recording state or sample preview is active.
tests.expected_observation: No silent interruption or unsafe mutation; Stop-and-Apply or clearly disabled action; no retained voice accesses freed memory.
tests.target_environment: Emulator + real A1200, no physical recording required

tests.title: Undo-retained memory
tests.actions: Observe free slots and allocation counts after deletion, undo, redo and later release of history.
tests.expected_observation: Report distinguishes logical deletion from actual resident reclamation; no double-counting or silent history purge.

tests.title: Clipboard/current editor/cache owners
tests.actions: Delete eligible material while transient editor/clipboard/cache state refers to it, then navigate/paste/undo as supported.
tests.expected_observation: Transient state is safely retained/invalidated by documented policy; no dangling reference or wrong replacement asset.

tests.title: Save/reload cleaned song
tests.actions: Save cleaned project and supported legacy representation to test-only paths; reload and play retained material.
tests.expected_observation: Only intended unreferenced content is absent; retained IDs/references/timing remain valid; source files untouched.

tests.title: Valid loop including final boundary
tests.actions: Select loop and visit both boundaries at several zoom levels.
tests.expected_observation: Selection is exact; zoom/view changes do not alter loop/data; final exclusive endpoint never reads beyond buffer.

tests.title: No loop, empty sample and invalid metadata
tests.actions: Invoke each loop action with absent/disabled loop; malformed cases in disposable emulator.
tests.expected_observation: Clear non-destructive status; no invented loop, automatic repair or crash.
tests.target_environment: Emulator; valid empty/no-loop cases on hardware

tests.title: Stale clipboard adversary
tests.actions: Copy region A to clipboard; mark distinct region B; invoke Copy Selection to Free Slot.
tests.expected_observation: Destination contains B, not A; source and ordinary clipboard policy remain correct.

tests.title: Selection boundaries and units
tests.actions: Copy first/last frames, full sample and declared size boundaries in every supported master representation.
tests.expected_observation: Exact requested representable range, checked lengths and preserved format/tuning; unrepresentable ranges refused/explained.
tests.target_environment: Emulator + representative formats on real A1200

tests.title: Contained and partial source loop
tests.actions: Copy a region containing the full loop, then one containing only part of it.
tests.expected_observation: Full loop translated correctly; partial loop disabled in new sample; source loop and bytes unchanged.

tests.title: No genuinely free slot
tests.actions: Populate/reserve/reference every destination, including a zero-length referenced or named slot.
tests.expected_observation: Clear failure without overwrite, auto-cleanup, renumbering or source mutation.

tests.title: Copy/edit independence and undo
tests.actions: Create sample, edit destination and source independently, then undo/redo each operation.
tests.expected_observation: No unintended aliasing; full sample/metadata restored; backend caches reflect each generation.

tests.title: Revision race, cancellation and partial allocation
tests.actions: Change source revision during preparation or cancel/fail a long copy before commit.
tests.expected_observation: Operation aborts/restarts safely; no partial slot publication or invalid retained allocation.
tests.target_environment: Emulator; user cancellation on real A1200

tests.title: Backend cache invalidation
tests.actions: Copy/edit/undo with each currently supported sample route, then audition explicitly.
tests.expected_observation: Audition reflects current master generation; masters are not silently downgraded to cache format.

tests.title: Explicit and instrument-only event
tests.actions: Navigate from explicit sample/instrument rows, including one with no pitch.
tests.expected_observation: Correct resource selected/opened without note playback or musical edits.

tests.title: Deterministic inherited instrument
tests.actions: Resolve zero-field events after instrument-only rows and across a known pattern/order boundary.
tests.expected_observation: Expected inherited target from independently specified state history, not current editor selection.

tests.title: Repeated/detached pattern ambiguity
tests.actions: Use the same pattern after two different entry histories; also view it without a song context.
tests.expected_observation: Correct target with unique known context; explicit ambiguity/unresolved status when context cannot identify one.

tests.title: Portamento and sounding-voice distinction
tests.actions: Use an event where explicit instrument selection and currently sounding sample need not match.
tests.expected_observation: Navigation identifies the labelled event target; never claims unsupported exact sounding-voice resolution.

tests.title: MIDI resource destination
tests.actions: Navigate explicit/inherited MIDI events and an empty/unknown instrument.
tests.expected_observation: Opens correct existing controls or clear unresolved state; no sample-slot confusion and no transmitted MIDI message.
tests.target_environment: Emulator + real A1200/MIDI monitor where available

tests.title: Resolver cache and route edits
tests.actions: Resolve, edit relevant order/instrument/route data, and resolve again; use a row not currently playing.
tests.expected_observation: No stale result or misuse of unrelated live channel state; no track routing changed by navigation.

tests.title: Origin/return and event propagation
tests.actions: Open target during playback and return to origin using keyboard/mouse controls.
tests.expected_observation: Original edit location retained; transport unaffected; no click-through, dirty musical data or unsolicited audition.

tests.title: 030 interaction measurements
tests.actions: Measure cold/warm manager open, navigation, loop jumps and long-copy/scan duration under recorded workloads.
tests.expected_observation: Report actual latency/work size/peak memory; no unsupported response claims; no prolonged unresponsive UI.

tests.title: Chip/Fast low-memory behaviour
tests.actions: Record allocations and safe failures near supported memory limits, including largest tested samples.
tests.expected_observation: No unbounded cache/undo growth, overflow, silent format downgrade or lost content.
tests.target_environment: Emulator stress + benign real A1200 case

tests.title: Repeated edit/cleanup cycles
tests.actions: Repeat defined copy/undo/redo/cleanup sequences, release history normally and compare retained allocations.
tests.expected_observation: No unaccounted growth after documented caches settle; all surviving resource owners valid.

tests.title: Playback coexistence
tests.actions: Compare identical fixture playback before/after feature changes while performing read-only UI actions.
tests.expected_observation: No new observable glitches or missed timing; evidence strength and capture limits explicitly recorded.

tests.title: Supported format/route matrix
tests.actions: Exercise core workflows across current native/legacy formats and supported Paula/AmiGUS/MIDI destinations.
tests.expected_observation: Unsupported/unfinished backend cases remain BLOCKED, not hidden or treated as passes; all available routes retain semantics.

tests.title: Pristine evidence and artifact review
tests.actions: Review diff, build artifact, keymap notes, fixture/result paths and untouched historical inputs.
tests.expected_observation: Changes isolated to intended 2.4G work; historical baseline and unrelated files unmodified.
